Only after both baseline files exist may you implement the worker.

Build the V2 account/position read-only monitor. This worker is MISSING_IN_V2 today. It must (a) call only read-only exchange endpoints (Binance GET /fapi/v3/account and GET /fapi/v2/positionRisk are the reference targets) and explicitly assert at startup that the configured client cannot reach any mutating endpoint, (b) classify itself as MISSING_CREDENTIALS when no read-only API keys are available rather than fabricating evidence, (c) NEVER conflate paper_online_runtime's simulated positions with real account positions, (d) write the public payload to v2/frontend/public/operator_runtime/v2_account_position_monitor/latest/, (e) include freshness_seconds and explicit MISSING_EVIDENCE labels for margin/leverage when not available. Tests must cover read-only endpoint usage, missing-credentials path, paper-vs-real isolation, fail-closed on 5xx/timeout, rate-limit backoff, and a contract test that fails if any mutating endpoint is wired up. Trigger codex_review_v2_account_position_monitor on emit.

SYMBOL_UNIVERSE_CONTRACT_REQUIRED. No worker may hardcode the current 25 symbols as the full universe. No worker may train or trade all discovered symbols automatically. CoinAnk symbols are market-intelligence candidates only until confirmed by Binance USD-M tradability evidence; do not treat CoinAnk symbols as directly tradable without Binance USD-M confirmation.
